 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Cleveland Browns running back Dylan Sampson ran eight times for 21 yards in Week 9 against the New Orleans saints, while adding three receptions for 27 yards on six targets.
 SOURCE: USA TODAY 
 Why it Matters: Sampson has been more of a low-end RB3 or flex fantasy option, with slightly more appeal in PPR leagues.
